tank_description: The T-72SH is a heavily armoured defender built around battlefield control and team support. Tough to dislodge from the front, it uses a range of disruption tools to control engagements and support its allies.

tank_summary: The T-72SH is designed around controlling the battlefield, supporting its allies and running interference on its opponents rather than operating as a lone frontline brawler. It is best placed where it can dictate the pace of an engagement and create opportunities for allies to capitalise on. Played effectively, the T-72SH functions more as a support than a traditional defender, albeit one that is exceptionally difficult to dislodge.

Featuring heavy frontal armour, the T-72SH is a difficult defender to deal with when engaged head-on. It is capable of standing its ground and absorbing punishment, making it particularly effective when contesting objectives or denying areas, especially when using its powerful team-support and crowd-control abilities to keep enemies at bay. Enemies pushing into the T-72SH will find the fight increasingly difficult the closer they get.

However, its large critical zones become a significant liability when attacked from the side or rear, or when the T-72SH is caught out of position. In an unfavourable engagement or ambush, the enemy can quickly destroy the T-72SH. Success therefore depends on positioning, teamwork and effective use of its disruption tools. When done right, this turns the T-72SH into an anchor that wins fights by controlling them rather than simply out-damaging the enemy. A fact that is made clear by its lacklustre main gun.
